role: Helper that loops ITokenMinterV2.mint(dispatcherIndex, recipient) count times, pulling aggregate payment once, with an owner-administered balance-based 'nudge' payout to the recipient when count >= nudgeSize.

verifiedProperties.noUnboundedLoops: batchMint loops `count` (caller-supplied, UNBOUNDED) but caller pays gas + real mint cost per iteration; over-large count self-DoS/reverts

localFindings.description: batchMint has NO ReentrancyGuard yet makes external mint() calls in a loop that (via NFTMinterV2._mint) invoke onERC1155Received on the caller-supplied `recipient` (attacker-controlled), while the function holds a payment-token balance AND performs a balance-snapshot-based nudge payout + dust refund. An attacker can set recipient to a malicious contract and re-enter batchMint mid-loop. Naive double-nudge-drain appears to self-revert (outer post-loop safeTransfer of a stale snapshot exceeds the now-reduced balance), but the full cross-contract exploitability depends on NFTMinterV2.mint semantics and cannot be adjudicated in isolation.
localFindings.recommendation: Surface to code-scanner (reentrancy checklist) + econ-scanner. Recommend adding ReentrancyGuard to batchMint as defense-in-depth. Note this is the same nudge-pot contract with H-01/M-01 history (see memory: batchminter-nudge).

localFindings.description: Balance-based nudge is winner-take-all: first qualifying batch takes the entire nudgePaymentToken pot. minReward floor only protects the LOSER from paying mint costs for a sniped reward; it does NOT prevent front-running the pot. Over-funding the pot is an owner footgun. Known (M-01 history), surfaced not new.
localFindings.recommendation: documented behaviour; owner funds pot conservatively.

externalEntryPoints.notes: minter+dispatcherIndex PINNED to owner state (not caller params) - closes the caller-supplied-minter drain vector. Payment token DERIVED from dispatcher.primeToken(). Nudge snapshot taken BEFORE loop (donate-forward). Nudge token must != payment token (up-front revert).
unconditional ERC20 sweep (owner-trusted escape hatch), callable while paused.

externalCalls.notes: inbound reentrancy callback, function NOT guarded

valueMath.dustRefund: remaining / DUST_THRESHOLD != 0 (i.e. remaining >= 1e6) triggers refund; else kept to absorb JS rounding
